title: Other instruments and dislike of piano
summary: He can play the brass valve instruments and took some piano but found it a girl's instrument.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I, I, I know the valve instruments. That's the trumpet and the baritone, and, uh, and, uh, the French horn and so forth. All, all the brass instruments I can play. And, uh, took a little piano from my mother, but, uh, I didn't care much for the piano. In those, uh, early years, uh, especially in Vernon, Texas, most pianists, uh, were the girls. And, uh, I don't know, I couldn't get it in my, in my, uh, head. It should be played by a boy. It seemed like a girl's instrument. And, I, I wanted to play the trombone.
